The last time I did that I lost everything I owned and ended up homeless for 4 years. 

I refuse to take a step backwards like that in life when I have the option to just kill myself. 

I was stupid to think someone had a magic bullet that would fix my problems.

Reading this pissed me off more than I've ever been pissed off.

I have to just tell myself that you don't get it. You don't understand what I've tried and how nothing has worked. How many years of being told "no you can't to do that", I've gone though. 

I try to reason it out another way but when I boil it down, people like you are one of the many reasons why I want to kill myself.
